title: FedV2X-Aid: code, results and reproduction scripts
description:
Code and result files behind the paper FedV2X-Aid: A V2X-Assisted Edge-IoT Framework for Label-Free Hazard Detection on Assistive Wearables (submitted to Discover Internet of Things, 2026).

The archive contains the scripts and archived outputs of the 15 computed studies, the federated-learning implementation with all baselines, the V2X and range-sensor teacher emulation, the outputs of the real-image experiments (E1 main comparison, E7 ablations, privacy and poisoning studies), the pre-registration of experiment E1, a one-command reproduction runner, and a tool that recomputes every computed number in the paper from the result files. The README lists installation steps and the command for each result.

Not included: the model weights and the merged label files, which are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request, and the third-party image datasets, which are available from their providers under their own licenses.
